answer: Resist sybils by requiring every identity to post a time-locked performance bond that vests only after several epochs of independently attested useful work. An attacker who spins up a herd must immobilize genuine capital on each sockpuppet; that collateral becomes a stranded island of locked funds, and there is no mid-epoch oasis where the same stake can be recycled into another persona. Peers check a crystal public record of bond age and attestation graphs, so cheap identity churn fails at admission and at settlement.
